assets.name: Liver & biliary anatomy
assets.description: Liver, gallbladder, bile duct and hepatic arteries.
assets.appearance: Liver and gallbladder surfaces use source tissue photographs.
assets.scope: Seven named source structures; tissue photographs describe appearance, not calibrated material properties.
assets.attribution: Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D, via SomaAtlas. Atlas adaptations: CC BY-SA 4.0, with upstream notices and source exceptions retained.
assets.use: Explore the anatomical relationships between the liver, biliary tract and hepatic arteries.

assets.name: Lungs
assets.description: Five lobes with pleural surface detail.
assets.appearance: Illustrated pleural tissue on five separate source atlas lobes.
assets.scope: Five lung lobes. The source model does not include the bronchi or trachea.
assets.attribution: Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D, via SomaAtlas. Atlas adaptations: CC BY-SA 4.0, with upstream notices and source exceptions retained.
assets.use: Separate the lobes to inspect their shape and spatial relationships.

assets.name: Muscles & tendons

assets.scope: 176 named source structures. Deep muscle groups are omitted in this superficial assembly.
assets.attribution: Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D, via SomaAtlas. Atlas adaptations: CC BY-SA 4.0, with upstream notices and source exceptions retained.
assets.use: Search and isolate individual superficial muscles and tendons across the body.
